title: Keep the ideal helicity obstruction at rho zero
statement: For smooth mean-zero divergence-free B on the closed unit torus,with rho0 and no direct magnetic forcing/disturbance, H(B)=integral curl^-1 B dot B is conserved regardless of momentum forcing. Since |H(B)|<=kappa^-1||B||2²,nonzero initial helicity prevents arbitrarily small L2 magnetic targets near zero. If rho>0,Hprime=-2rho integral B dot curl B instead; the ideal argument does NOT prove a resistive no-go. Nonzero magnetic mean is an additional torus obstruction to zero targets. Boundary-control theorems on different domains and control ports do not remove or transfer these hypotheses.
